fx-dr2.name: FX-DR2
fx-dr2.description: Delay and reverb for the DJ booth. Repeats locked to the track's tempo, reverbs with character, a filter and Freeze, all on one screen.

mode: With the pedal off, hold down either of the two MODE buttons.
Power it on, still holding MODE, until the screen says:
steps.connect: Connect the USB-C on the back of the pedal straight to the computer, with no hub or adapter in between.
steps.wrongPort: Use the USB-C on the back of the pedal, with the pedal in FIRMWARE UPDATE.
steps.exit: To leave update mode without updating, power the pedal off and on.

iso-f1.name: ISO-F1
iso-f1.description: A fully analog 3-band isolator and DJ-style filter in one compact stereo unit.

mode: With the ISO-F1 off, hold down SHIFT.
Power it on, still holding SHIFT: it starts in update mode.
steps.connect: Connect the ISO-F1's USB straight to the computer, with no hub in between.
steps.exit: To leave update mode without updating, power the ISO-F1 off and on.

performance-mixer.name: Performance Mixer
performance-mixer.description: Central mixing hub for your modular setup. Knob recording (REC) captures your volume, pan and aux moves.

mode: Connect the module's USB to the computer, with the module powered.
Hold down BOOT, press and release RESET, then release BOOT.
steps.connect: Use the module's USB, straight to the computer, with no hub in between.
steps.exit: To leave DFU mode without updating, press RESET.

vcv-random.name: VCV Random
vcv-random.description: Random CV generator with 4 types of randomness, a triggerable sample-and-hold and self-modulation.

mode: Connect the module's USB to the computer, with the module powered.
Hold down BOOT, press and release RESET, then release BOOT.
steps.connect: Use the module's USB, straight to the computer, with no hub in between.
steps.exit: To leave DFU mode without updating, press RESET.

fum.name: FUM
fum.description: Six stereo effects, direct control: Delay, Reverb, Pitch, Chorus/Flanger, Texture and a Color filter, each on one bipolar knob.

mode: Connect the Daisy module's own USB to the computer, with the module powered.
On the Daisy module, hold down BOOT, press and release RESET, then release BOOT.
steps.connect: Use the USB on the Daisy module itself, straight to the computer, with no hub in between.
steps.exit: To leave DFU mode without updating, press RESET on the Daisy module.
